establishments.name: Perth Children's Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Perth Children's Hospital is part of CAHS (DoH CRS page, 8 Sep 2026; SLIP lists it under the North Metro geographic service).

establishments.name: St John of God Bunbury Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Private hospital (St John of God Health Care) in the WACHS South West area; HEALTH-001 flags outpatient reporting. Contract detail not verified.

establishments.name: St John of God Mt Lawley Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Mount Lawley Hospital: purchased from St John of God Health Care by the WA Government, transferring to State ownership on 31 Aug 2026 (WA Government media statement, 1 May 2026); listed on the EMHS website (26 Oct 2026). HEALTH-001 still lists it as Private.

establishments.name: Joondalup Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Joondalup Health Campus is operated by Ramsay Health Care under a public-private arrangement; listed under NMHS on the DoH CRS page. HEALTH-001 lists it as Private.

establishments.name: Peel Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Peel Health Campus returned to public hands (SMHS) on 13 Aug 2024; listed under SMHS on the DoH CRS page. HEALTH-001 still lists it as Private.

establishments.name: St John of God Midland Hospital
establishments.hspNote: St John of God Midland Public Hospital is operated by St John of God Health Care under a public-private arrangement; listed under EMHS (EMHS website and DoH CRS page). HEALTH-001 lists it as Private.
